name: Coast Guard Air Station Borinquen
tagline: The Coast Guard air station on the former Ramey Air Force Base in Aguadilla, with Coast Guard housing and a DoDEA school.
coords_source: approximate point on the former Ramey AFB, from public maps
_note: Written on 2026-11-21 by scripts/guides/write_missed_guides.py from the official pages named in each section. Not in the first installation list; added after the missed-bases check.

data.Location: Aguadilla, northwest Puerto Rico (former Ramey Air Force Base)
data.School: Ramey School, DoDEA, pre-K to grade 12

sections.title: Housing
data: Coast Guard family housing is less than a mile from the air station, in two-, three- and four-bedroom homes with air conditioning, an electric stove and a refrigerator. Families bring their own washer and dryer.
Assignment to Coast Guard family housing is mandatory when a home is available and adequate.

source.label: Coast Guard Base Detachment Borinquen, Housing Department

sections.title: Housing allowance (OHA, not BAH)
data: Puerto Rico is an overseas location for housing allowances. Service members who live off base receive the Overseas Housing Allowance (OHA) instead of BAH. OHA is set by rank, dependents and the actual rent, up to a ceiling, with separate amounts for utilities and move-in costs.
Check your own figures with the official OHA calculator before you sign a lease.

source.label: Defense Travel Management Office, Overseas Housing Allowance

sections.title: Schools
data: Ramey School is a DoDEA school for pre-K through grade 12 in Aguadilla, for children of Coast Guard and other federal personnel. The installation's school page says registration is usually the last week of July and classes start in mid-August.

sections.title: Child care
data: The Borinquen Child Development Center is licensed by the Coast Guard and accredited by NAEYC. It serves infants through pre-K and runs a program for school-age children.
